Oyster Perpetual

Time-only wristwatch · 28mm, 31mm, 34mm, 36mm, 39mm, 41mm across eras · 100 metres / 330 feet · automatic

The Oyster Perpetual is Rolex's quintessential time-only wristwatch, defined by its waterproof Oyster case and self-winding Perpetual movement. It represents the purest expression of the brand's core principles of precision, durability, and timeless style.

The story

The Oyster Perpetual was introduced in 1931, combining two of Rolex's groundbreaking innovations: the waterproof "Oyster" case from 1926 and the self-winding "Perpetual" rotor mechanism. This combination created a robust and reliable timepiece that became the foundation for most of Rolex's subsequent collections. Throughout the mid-20th century, the design was refined with cleaner dials and sleeker cases, housing workhorse movements like the 1500-series calibers. The late 20th century saw the introduction of more modern movements and the use of sapphire crystals. In 2020, the line was significantly updated with new case sizes, a new generation of calibers, and a vibrant new range of dial colors, cementing its position as both a classic entry point and a sought-after model in its own right.
